flash_696947.description: The dean of the University of Toronto’s Faculty of Dentistry has resigned following an investigation into antisemitic images included in lecture materials presented to students earlier this year.

flash_696932.description: Dr. Phil explains the real reason the world hates the Jews and Israel.

flash_696955.description:
UFC CEO Dana White announced Saturday night that he will meet with US President Donald Trump at the White House on Sunday to discuss the offer to become White House press secretary. His announcement contradicts an earlier CNN report claiming that White had already turned down the position.

Speaking to reporters at a boxing event in London, White said he was heading to Washington and would be able to provide more details after the meeting. He declined to say whether he was seriously considering accepting the position, noting that he already has numerous responsibilities.

flash_696954.description: Iran's Revolutionary Guard removes its 2,000-kilometer missile range restriction as tensions with the US and Israel escalate despite ongoing nuclear diplomacy.

flash_696950.description: Anti-Netanyahu bloc, Arab parties, seek to use transition period to roll back judicial reform laws, establish temporary Knesset committees.

flash_696948.description: CENTCOM says US military aircraft struck vessel in Gulf of Oman after crew ignored repeated warnings, made multiple attempts to violate the blockade.

flash_696944.description: Like Abraham, we should determine what we want to achieve with our lives and search for the spouse who will most help us to attain our objective.

flash_696942.description: Firefighters rescue two at Dror Interchange, respond to 11 flood-related rescue incidents across the Central District, urging the public to avoid flooded areas.

flash_696982.description: Bat Yam Municipality files lawsuit against Iran over ballistic missile attack that killed 9 civilians and injured hundreds, with the mayor personally delivering the papers to Iranisn officials.

flash_696981.description: Defense Minister warns that Iran is renewing its efforts to obtain nuclear weapons: "We cannot tolerate these threats."

flash_696979.description: A Rishon LeZion resident who was 29 weeks pregnant was found in critical condition at her home and rushed to Sheba Medical Center. Medical staff fought to save her life but were ultimately forced to pronounce her dead.

flash_696977.description: According to Polish authorities, the suspect is a machinist with no military background who legally held a firearms license and acted alone. He was shot by police and remains hospitalized in serious condition.

flash_696975.description: A minibus driver in his 50s was seriously injured and 16 others were hurt when his vehicle crashed into a concrete wall near the Rokach Interchange.

flash_696973.description: Bat Yam Municipality files lawsuit against Iran over ballistic missile attack that killed 9 civilians and injured hundreds.

flash_696971.description: Otzma Yehudit chairman claims the election results were manipulated, disputes Justice Noam Sohlberg's position, and demands that new elections be held.

flash_696969.description: The Honenu organization is demanding the return of an excavator used by the IDF during the war, along with tools worth tens of thousands of shekels, to a couple from Gush Etzion.

flash_696967.description: Politics now plays the role religion used to play in most people’s lives. For many their faith is liberalism and the Democrats, with Jewish peoplehood and Israel discarded. Opinion.

flash_696965.description: Israel and Irish Jewish leaders condemn UN rapporteur over allegations of sexual abuse and torture made during an Irish parliamentary hearing.

flash_696958.description:
The Brooklyn Nets suffered a 124-121 road loss to the Atlanta Hawks on Saturday night after leading for most of the game but surrendering their advantage in the final minutes of the fourth quarter. The defeat dropped Brooklyn's record to 2-7 this season.

Israeli basketball player Danny Wolf, who started for Brooklyn, finished with 11 points, nine rebounds, and one assist. Fellow Israeli Ben Saraf did not play after being assigned to the Nets' NBA G League affiliate.

flash_696956.description: Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis questions the objectives of the Iran war and warns of a prolonged conflict.

flash_696953.description: Israeli Ambassador Danny Danon challenges Turkish UN chief candidate Feridun Sinirlioğlu over his past opposition to condemning Hamas, demanding an unequivocal response.

flash_697009.description:
The Iranian Navy claimed that an oil tanker struck a naval mine and caught fire east of the Strait of Hormuz.

According to the Iranian military, the tanker was sailing in a prohibited area after switching off its identification systems and was operating in violation of regulations.

flash_697008.description:
Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi issued an ultimatum to the White House, calling on Washington to accept Tehran's demands, including an end to the war on all fronts. He said Iran's proposal remains on the table.

"Meet our demands and you will see the results. Or choose war, and see how our experienced and battle-ready fighters rain hellfire down on you," he threatened.

flash_697006.description: The IDF Spokesperson's Unit reported that sirens were activated in the Nir Oz area. The circumstances of the incident are being investigated.

flash_697004.description: Visiting Israel Benghazi veteran Mark Geist says the fight is ultimately one of good versus evil, calls for US-Israel unity, and credits Trump's leadership as essential to achieving peace in the Middle East.

flash_697002.description: Israeli President Isaac Herzog tasks Yashar! chairman Gadi Eisenkot with forming a government, after 67 MKs recommended him.

flash_697000.description: Why Israel's election scandal demands an uncompromising investigation. Opinion.

flash_696998.description:
Yashar party chairman Gadi Eisenkot, who is expected to receive the mandate to form a government today, does not plan to swear in a new government before the Knesset speaker is replaced, even if he succeeds in forming one beforehand.

The replacement of the Knesset speaker is scheduled for next week, and Eisenkot is expected to wait until then before holding the swearing-in ceremony.

flash_696997.description: Amid right-wing pressure to oppose an Arab-backed minority government, Elisaf Peretz says he trusts Gadi Eisenkot to make the right decisions for Israel.

flash_696995.description:
The Yashar party has denied a report by Shlomo Rizel claiming that Gadi Eisenkot is negotiating with foreign officials over an Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon.

The party described the report as an "outright lie, completely devoid of any factual basis."

The party demanded that Channel 14 remove the report immediately and that Rizel issue a public apology. In its statement, the party claimed that the publication was intended to thwart the formation of a new government.

flash_696994.description: JPPI poll finds that of 10 scenarios, only a government of Likud, Yashar, Beyachad and Yisrael Beytenu is not rejected by a majority of respondents. Opposition-bloc including haredi parties receives support of just 3%.

flash_696993.description: Following heavy rainfall in Gaza, COGAT reports the delivery of thousands of trucks carrying winter supplies, alongside, vaccines and sanitation equipment, while stressing that reconstruction cannot begin until Hamas disarms.

flash_696991.description:
The Palestinian police located an Israeli couple and their one-year-old son near a hotel in Bethlehem on Thursday. The three were handed over to Israeli security forces in good health.

The parents, Jerusalem residents aged 41 and 34, were questioned at the Etzion police station on suspicion of entering a restricted area. They were subsequently released under restrictive conditions.

According to police, the search began after the father called the 100 emergency hotline at around 8:25 p.m., claiming that he had accidentally entered Area A along with tourists.

The family was located through coordination between the Israel Police, the IDF and the Palestinian police.

flash_696990.description:
Around 60 people were injured in an initial report of a collision between two passenger trains in the Al-Ayyat area of Egypt's Giza Governorate.

Several carriages derailed in the collision, and according to reports, four of them overturned.

Read More

flash_696988.description: The Beit Hamikdash is not a normal building, a structure made of walls. It is where the Shechina will be revealed.

flash_696986.description: Journalist Abed Abu Shahadeh is released without restrictions after five days in custody over an interview with Azmi Bishara; investigation continues.

flash_696984.description: A Tel Aviv resident has been charged with breaking into a yeshiva and stealing approximately 10 pairs of tefillin, cash, and a charity box.

flash_696980.description: A 16-year-old eastern Jerusalem resident was arrested on suspicion of tearing a mezuzah from a home in Silwan and spray-painting graffiti on its door.

flash_697024.description:
An Israel Air Force exercise will take place Monday at approximately 6:00 a.m. over Nahariya and the surrounding area.

During the exercise, aircraft will fly at low altitudes, and sounds of explosions will be heard. There is no security threat.

flash_697023.description: Yisrael Beytenu chair Avigdor Liberman denies report of draft concessions in secret talks with United Torah Judaism, calling it 'lies and fabrications.'

flash_697021.description: As anti-Israel sentiment spreads across America's political divide, Dr. Joe Frager warns of the toughest climate in his 45 years of advocacy. But despite the growing hostility, he predicts a turning point: "It'll get worse before it gets better."

flash_697018.description: In response to UK initiative calling for expanded aid to Gaza, Israel's Ambassador to the UN Danny Danon says, 'Instead of giving Israel a list of demands, it is time to demand the dismantling of Hamas.'

flash_697017.description: The Union of Ukrainian Expatriates warns that unauthorized construction and renovation work is damaging historic Jewish burial sites, calling for a central rabbinical authority to protect them.

flash_697015.description: Israel Justice Organization board member Jonathan Burkan tells Arutz Sheva Israel should build new alliances, strengthen weapons production, ahead of a possible shift in US relations.

flash_697013.description: Vance is entitled to argue that the Iran war cost Republicans the election. But he should not be allowed to use those arguments to blame Israel and thereby bypass his administration’s own failed record. Opinion.

flash_697011.description: Washington offers up to $20 million and political asylum to anyone providing new intelligence on Iran’s nuclear facilities, equipment or personnel, as concerns grow over Tehran’s nuclear activities.

flash_697007.description: IDF troops uncover weapons stockpiles, Hezbollah military apartment 100 to 250 meters from UN posts in southern Lebanon.

flash_697005.description: Thousands of Chabad emissaries from 111 countries gathered outside 770 in Brooklyn for their traditional group photo, held in the shadow of the deadly Sydney Hanukkah attack last year that claimed 16 lives.

flash_697003.description: Over 140 suspects apprehended, approximately 35 weapons located during operations by the Judea and Etzion Brigades.

flash_697001.description:
A two-year-old boy was brought to the Magen David Adom (MDA) station in Arad after apparently being struck by a vehicle.

MDA medical teams provided emergency treatment and evacuated him to Soroka Medical Center in Beersheba in critical condition, while performing CPR. He suffered multiple traumatic injuries.

flash_696999.description: Shas chairman Aryeh Deri has decided not to serve as a member of the Knesset in the upcoming term. Two other members, Moshe Abutbul and Dror Amos, have also resigned from the party's Knesset list.

flash_696996.description:
Pro-Palestinian activists replaced the German flag flying outside the Reichstag, the German parliament building, with a Palestinian flag overnight.

Footage released from the scene shows Berlin firefighters working to remove the flag several hours after it was raised.

The incident occurred one day before the 88th anniversary of Kristallnacht, the Nazi pogrom against Jews in Germany on November 9-10, 1938.

flash_697031.description:
Amid ongoing talks to form a government led by Gadi Eisenkot's bloc, messages were broadcast over loudspeakers in Bnei Brak opposing the possibility of haredi parties supporting such a government.

Among the slogans heard was: "We will not support those who seek to destroy Judaism."

flash_697030.description: Trump says Gadi Eisenkot and Benjamin Netanyahu share similar policies after Eisenkot receives the mandate to form Israel's next government.

flash_697029.description:
Police arrested 11 suspects, including a woman and minors, following disturbances during a gathering of dozens of people in Lod. According to police, the suspects disobeyed officers' instructions and disrupted public order.

Police clarified that "contrary to reports that circulated, no stabbing occurred at the scene."

flash_697028.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio says a deal with Iran remains out of reach, calling Tehran's demands unrealistic.

flash_697027.description:
IDF troops operating Sunday evening in the Zababdeh area spotted a terrorist holding a firebomb and preparing to throw it at the soldiers.

According to the IDF Spokesperson's Unit, the troops opened fire at the terrorist to eliminate the threat, and a hit was confirmed.

flash_697026.description: Trump highlights a new task force targeting Iran's supply routes and warns of further strikes, as Iranian media report explosions on Qeshm Island.

flash_697025.description: The arrests of yeshiva students were also a purely political tactic. Opinion.

flash_697022.description:
A 50-year-old man was seriously injured in a violent incident on HaTikva Street in Tel Aviv.

Magen David Adom (MDA) paramedics treated him at the scene before evacuating him to Ichilov Hospital in the city.

flash_697020.description:
Jerusalem District police officers opened fire on a vehicle traveling toward Isawiya after the driver allegedly endangered their lives during an attempt to stop it. The vehicle's occupants were arrested, and four were taken to the hospital for medical treatment.

Police suspect that the vehicle was transporting illegal residents.

flash_697055.description: Eleven people sickened at wedding in Beitar Illit; seven children hospitalized.

flash_697054.description: A new National Cyber Directorate survey finds that 98% of Israelis are aware of online threats, yet only one-third feel equipped to deal with them. Two-thirds received suspicious text messages in a single month.

flash_697053.description: Emet L'Yaakov presses Movement for Quality Government for answers about how it handled election complaints involving different communities.

flash_697051.description: Former minister launches scathing attack on Aryeh Deri, accusing him of sidelining the Council of Torah Sages, failing to deliver for Shas voters and refusing to take responsibility for the party's failures.

flash_697049.description: The history of German Jewry shows that achievement, prominence, and attachment to a country cannot guarantee a minority’s security. When antisemitism moves from the margins into mainstream politics, and discrimination and intimidation become acceptable, it is time to prepare to leave. Op-ed.

flash_697044.description: After 11 years, Israel brought Hadar Goldin home - then uncovered and destroyed the 16-kilometer Hamas tunnel network where his remains had been hidden, pumping in more than 30,000 cubic meters of concrete.

flash_697041.description: Three activists arrested after replacing a German flag with a PLO flag outside parliament in Berlin during a protest against Germany's support for Israel.

flash_697039.description: Trump urges Netanyahu to move forward with his Gaza peace plan following Israel's elections, as Washington seeks progress on Hamas disarmament and Gaza governance.

flash_697037.description: Rabbi Shlomo Yedidya Zafrani, a prominent Sephardic haredi rabbi, addresses the possibility of joining a government led by the current opposition.

flash_697035.description: Shin Bet chief David Zini sought to launch formal investigations into five Arab party leaders, including Yousef Jabareen, Ahmed Tibi, and Mansour Abbas.

flash_697033.description: Trump says Israel would not exist without his strikes on Iran's nuclear facilities, while blaming the Iran war and hostility towards the Jewish state for Republican election losses.
